_comment: Watchman eyes policy — the CONFIGURABLE extension of the denylist. TWO LEGS. The DECLARATION leg (denylist_queues / denylist_tools / denylist_domains) reads what the writer declared. The CONTENT leg (content_terms) reads the REDACTED body and the sanitized metadata, homoglyph-folded — because sensitivity is not always self-declared. The protected/consent floor (tool comms_acknowledge; 'protected' or 'consent' anywhere in an item's metadata) is hard-coded in sanitizer.py and CANNOT be turned off here. Entries here only ADD metadata-only classes. Schema is STRICTLY validated: every listed key must be a list of strings. A missing file falls back to compiled-in seeds identical to these values (policy_state 'builtin-fallback'); a file that exists but does not validate closes the eyes completely (policy_state 'floor-fallback', metadata-only for everything) and raises an attend line about this file. Over-withholding is accepted by design — Grok's flag-for-richer-review covers what a withheld preview costs.
